name: Ose Akito
source:
A member of the 'Kikujin' Shinigami company.
Because he has the blood of the spider youkai 'Tsuchigumo' he can create spider silk threads to fight with.
He loves harassing other people and has a bad personality.
He's interested in the protagonist and is always making passes at her, even after they became allies he wont let up.
translation:
A member of the 'Kikujin' Shinigami company.
Because he has the blood of the spider youkai 'Tsuchigumo' he can create spider silk threads to fight with.
He loves harassing other people and has a bad personality.
He's interested in the protagonist and is always making passes at her, even after they became allies he wont let up.
